nodes.name: armors.json
nodes.summary: Armor set definitions for all armor pieces in Voxel Blade. Each entry includes name, shared stats (upgrade level, stat bonuses, associated perk), and parts (helmet, chestplate, leggings) with descriptions.

nodes.name: blades.json
nodes.summary: Blade weapon data for all blade types. Each entry includes tier, attack speed, stat scaling values, damage types, associated perks, and blade category (Medium/Small/Heavy/Hammer Head).

nodes.name: Boost.ts
nodes.summary: Defines damage boost calculation structures and all damage-boosting perk definitions. Contains BOOST_DEFS array with entries for each damage-boosting perk (simple multiplier-based and complex calculation-function-based), the BoostContext interface for boost evaluation context, and the BoostDef type.

nodes.name: calcMinionAbsorptionPotency
nodes.summary: Calculates damage boost potency from Minion Absorption perk based on summon boost percentage and perk stacks.

nodes.name: calcFrenzyPct
nodes.summary: Calculates Frenzy damage percentage from rage potency value.

nodes.name: BuffData.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive buff/debuff/neutral status effect definitions for Voxel Blade. Contains BUFF_DEFS recording all buff types, granted buff definitions from items/perks/weapon arts/races, the PERK_BUFFS factory map for generating buffs from perks, buff potency modifiers, debuff modifiers, and helper functions for assembling active buffs from a full build configuration.

nodes.name: formatDamageTypes
nodes.summary: Formats an array of damage type strings into a human-readable list.

nodes.name: getWeaponArtBuffs
nodes.summary: Returns granted buffs associated with a specific weapon art name.

nodes.name: getTrueBalanceBuffs
nodes.summary: Computes True Balance perk conversion buffs from active debuffs on the target.

nodes.name: durationMultFromStack
nodes.summary: Factory that creates a duration multiplier function from base + per-stack values.

nodes.name: getSpecificBuffModifiers
nodes.summary: Applies specific perk modifiers (e.g. Fury, Mage Rage) to a buff's potency and duration.

nodes.name: getBastionBlessBonus
nodes.summary: Calculates additional potency bonus from Bastion Bless perk for non-debuff, non-neutral buffs.

nodes.name: getGenericDebuffModifiers
nodes.summary: Applies generic debuff modifiers (Endless Despair, Stored Corruption) to debuff potency and duration.

nodes.name: getTricksterReflection
nodes.summary: Calculates Trickster perk's reflected potency bonus for Despair self-debuffs.

nodes.name: applyBuffPerkModifiers
nodes.summary: Main modifier pipeline applying all perk-based buff modifiers to a list of granted buffs.

nodes.name: applyToxinTransferDuration
nodes.summary: Adjusts Toxin Transfer Poison debuff duration based on the player's self-Poison duration.

nodes.name: convertTailwindToWhirlwind
nodes.summary: Converts Tailwind buffs to Whirlwind buffs when the player has the Whirlwind perk.

nodes.name: getBuffDescription
nodes.summary: Generates a human-readable description string for a buff based on its potency.

nodes.name: getPerkBuffs
nodes.summary: Generates all granted buffs from the PERK_BUFFS factory map based on a perks record.

nodes.name: getActiveBuildBuffs
nodes.summary: Collects item-source buffs from a build's equipment slots and race.

nodes.name: getRaceBuffs
nodes.summary: Returns race-specific base buffs for a given race name.

nodes.name: applyCauterizeConversion
nodes.summary: Converts enemy Burn debuffs to Singed (burst) mode when Cauterize perk is active.

nodes.name: getBurnApplicationCount
nodes.summary: Counts the number of enemy Burn application entries in a buff list.

nodes.name: assembleActiveBuffs
nodes.summary: Full assembly pipeline: item buffs + perk buffs + weapon art buffs, modified and merged.

nodes.name: calcBuffEffect
nodes.summary: Calculates the numeric effect value and display label for a buff at a given potency.

nodes.name: calcPotencyPercent
nodes.summary: Calculates potency display percentage from a perk amount value.

nodes.name: formatPerkDescription
nodes.summary: Formats a perk description string by replacing x% placeholder with calculated potency.

nodes.name: cdr.ts
nodes.summary: Perk cooldown reduction data definitions. Maps perk names to CDR entries containing rune/weapon art cooldown reduction percentages, multipliers, and optional rune/WA filters.

nodes.name: debuffCombatEffects.ts
nodes.summary: Combat effect definitions for debuffs. Each debuff entry provides description functions, damage multipliers, defense reduction calculations, and type-specific damage multipliers (e.g., Sticky increases magic/fire/earth damage taken).

nodes.name: defensivePerks.ts
nodes.summary: Defensive perk damage reduction definitions. Contains DEFENSIVE_PERK_SOURCES array with per-perk DR values, conditions, and context-dependent activation logic. Provides getActiveDefensivePerkSources and calcDefensivePotencyMult functions.

nodes.name: getActiveDefensivePerkSources
nodes.summary: Filters and calculates active defensive perk sources based on context (HP, darkness, rage, mounted, etc.).

nodes.name: calcDefensivePotencyMult
nodes.summary: Calculates defensive potency multiplier from Bastion Bless and draconic infusion bonuses.

nodes.name: DoTDamage.ts
nodes.summary: Damage-over-time (DoT) calculation logic for Bleed, Burn, and Poison. Defines stat scalings per DoT type, damage type mapping for defense mitigation, base damage formula, potency multiplier calculation, and helper functions for converting builder values to game-internal values.

nodes.name: getDotBase
nodes.summary: Returns flat base damage before potency multiplier using infliction potency.

nodes.name: getDotPotencyMult
nodes.summary: Returns the potency multiplier for DoT damage, with capped exponent at dotPotency >= 1.

nodes.name: calcDotTick
nodes.summary: Computes a single DoT tick damage for given dot potency and infliction potency.

nodes.name: toGamePotency
nodes.summary: Converts a builder-display perk value to the game-internal value (0.1 per display point).

nodes.name: calcDotDisplayPotency
nodes.summary: Computes effective DoT display potency with optional Endless Despair modifier.

nodes.name: draconicBuffs.ts
nodes.summary: Draconic guild buff and debuff generation. Provides functions to get draconic infusion potency/duration multipliers, generate Draconic Infusion buff entries with color-specific effects, and generate Dragon Claw/Bubble ability debuffs for hex and fire colors.

nodes.name: getDraconicInfusionPotMult
nodes.summary: Calculates the potency multiplier from Draconic Blood perk amount.

nodes.name: getDraconicInfusionDurMult
nodes.summary: Calculates the duration multiplier from Draconic Blood perk amount.

nodes.name: getEffectiveDraconicInfusionPotency
nodes.summary: Returns the effective draconic infusion buff potency after modifiers.

nodes.name: getDraconicInfusionBuff
nodes.summary: Generates Draconic Infusion buff entries with color-specific effects for Draconic guild members.

nodes.name: getDraconicAbilityDebuffs
nodes.summary: Generates debuffs for Draconic guild abilities (Dragon Claw, Dragon Bubble) based on color.

nodes.name: draconicColorEffects.ts
nodes.summary: Draconic color-specific combat stat definitions. Maps each draconic color (fire/air/earth/water/holy/hex) to its damage, speed, knockback, cooldown, and stun multipliers, plus color metadata and a lookup function.

nodes.name: getDraconicColorDmgMultiplier
nodes.summary: Looks up the damage multiplier for a given draconic color.

nodes.name: getDraconicColorAttackStats
nodes.summary: Returns full attack stats for a given draconic color from the lookup map.

nodes.name: draconicRunes.ts
nodes.summary: Draconic rune and infusion bonus application logic. Provides functions to apply draconic rune stacks and dragon infusion bonuses to damage type distributions, plus combined application and bonus retrieval.

nodes.name: applyDraconicRunesBonus
nodes.summary: Applies draconic rune stacks as a bonus to the matching color damage type.

nodes.name: getDraconicRunesBonus
nodes.summary: Returns the bonus damage type entries from draconic rune stacks.

nodes.name: applyDragonInfusionBonus
nodes.summary: Applies dragon infusion buff potency as bonus to the matching color damage type.

nodes.name: getDragonInfusionBonus
nodes.summary: Returns the bonus damage type entries from dragon infusion buff.

nodes.name: applyDraconicBonuses
nodes.summary: Combines rune and infusion bonuses into a damage type distribution.

nodes.name: getDraconicBonuses
nodes.summary: Returns combined bonus entries from both rune and infusion sources.

nodes.name: enchantments.json
nodes.summary: Enchantment definitions for weapons and armor. Each entry includes name, category (unAscended/Ascended), stacking behavior, stat modifiers (multiplier/addition for various stats), and optional effects (perk grants).

nodes.name: enemyHpEffects.ts
nodes.summary: Enemy HP-gated debuff and DoT damage boost definitions. Defines effects that activate based on enemy HP thresholds, such as Mycotic Bloom applying Slowness above 50% HP or boosting Poison damage below 50% HP.

nodes.name: isEnemyHpGateActive
nodes.summary: Checks whether an enemy HP gate condition is active given current enemy HP percentage.

nodes.name: getActiveEnemyHpDebuffs
nodes.summary: Returns active debuffs from enemy-HP-gated perk effects based on current enemy HP and active debuffs.

nodes.name: getEnemyHpDotMultiplier
nodes.summary: Calculates the DoT damage multiplier from enemy-HP-gated effects for a given DoT type.

nodes.name: essences.json
nodes.summary: Essence weapon component data for all essence types. Each entry includes tier, attack speed, stat scaling values, damage types, and associated perks. Mirrors blade.json structure for the essence weapon slot.

nodes.name: gloves.json
nodes.summary: Monk glove weapon data for all glove types. Each entry includes tier, attack speed, stat scaling, damage types, and spirit/perk associations. Includes both Gloves and Shield types.

nodes.name: guilds.json
nodes.summary: Guild rank definitions for all guilds (Gladiator, Cursed, Cleric, Scholar, Knight, Thief, Draconic, Monk, Vampire). Each rank provides stat bonuses and perk grants.

nodes.name: handles.json
nodes.summary: Handle weapon component data for all handle types. Each entry includes tier, attack speed, stat scaling values, handle type category (Medium/Long/Pole), and associated perks.

nodes.name: HealBoost.ts
nodes.summary: Healing boost calculation system. Defines HEAL_SCALING_DEFS array with perk and rune sources that modify healing output (Emotional, Heal Boost, Oceans Rage, Vampire Sunlight penalty, Frenzy self-heal penalty, Dragon Infusion holy bonus). Provides calculateHealBoost function for computing final healing multiplier.

nodes.name: calculateHealBoost
nodes.summary: Computes final healing boost multiplier from all active perk, rune, and passive sources.

nodes.name: getHealScalingMultiplier
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper that returns only the final heal boost multiplier from calculateHealBoost.

nodes.name: mountRunes.ts
nodes.summary: Mount rune definitions for mounted combat. Defines M1 and Weapon Art stats for Winter Woof, Slizard, and Glacial Snapper mounts, including base damage, damage types, scalings, guardbreak, cooldown, and secondary effects.

nodes.name: getMountRuneDef
nodes.summary: Looks up a mount rune definition by rune name.

nodes.name: perkAutoDebuffs.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated debuff logic for perks. Contains getAutoDebuffs function that determines which debuffs a build automatically applies based on equipped perks and combat context (Exhaust, Penance, Melting Shred, Fungal Prototype, Venom Spitter, Toxin Caster, Gorecast, Splinter, Bellowing Ember, Frostbite, Gelid Lance, Weakening, Sunburn, Fiery Pursuit, Pyre Bloom, Runic Blades, Hypnotist, Cryo Engine, and enemy HP-gated debuffs).

nodes.name: calcActualHpFillPct
nodes.summary: Calculates effective HP fill percentage accounting for negative protection (which reduces max HP).

nodes.name: getAutoDebuffs
nodes.summary: Generates all automatically-applied debuffs from a build's perks and combat context.

nodes.name: Perkbasedmg.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive perk-based damage definitions. Contains PERK_DMG_DEFS array with damage calculation entries for all offensive perks (spirits, weapon art replacements, runes, finishers, etc.). Each entry defines base damage, hit count, damage type mode, scaling mode, proc coefficient, HP gates, secondary effects, and sliders. Also provides helper types and functions for HP gate checking and perk damage definition lookup.

nodes.name: gateThreshold
nodes.summary: Returns the effective HP gate threshold value, accounting for always-active at certain perk amounts.

nodes.name: isHpGateActive
nodes.summary: Checks whether an HP gate condition is active given current HP fill percentage and perk amount.

nodes.name: calcSpringblastBaseDamage
nodes.summary: Calculates Springblast perk base damage from perk amount.

nodes.name: calcBomberChargeBaseDamage
nodes.summary: Calculates Bomber Charge perk base damage from perk amount and missing HP percentage.

nodes.name: findPerkDmgDef
nodes.summary: Looks up a PerkDmgDef by perk name and optional label.

nodes.name: perks.json
nodes.summary: Master perk definitions for Voxel Blade. Each entry includes perk name, description text, and categorization tags (Offensive, Defensive, Buff, Debuff, etc.). Comprehensive reference of all game perks.

nodes.name: potions.ts
nodes.summary: Potion definitions for Rage Potion and Poison Potion with name, description, and color properties. Provides POTIONS array and POTION_MAP lookup.

nodes.name: procCoefficients.ts
nodes.summary: Proc coefficient data for weapon types and weapon arts. Maps weapon style names to M1/M2 proc coefficients and weapon art names to their proc coefficients. Used for determining which attacks can proc on-hit effects.

nodes.name: raceEffects.ts
nodes.summary: Race-specific conditional effects. Defines Human race passive (below 50% HP damage boost and flat DR), Ork tenacity calculation from active buff count, and helper functions for race effect activation.

nodes.name: getActiveRaceEffect
nodes.summary: Returns the active race conditional effect for a given race name and HP percentage.

nodes.name: getOrkTenacityBuffs
nodes.summary: Filters active buffs to count unique non-debuff, non-neutral buff entries for Ork tenacity.

nodes.name: calcOrkTenacityBonus
nodes.summary: Calculates Ork tenacity bonus from the count of unique active buffs.
